tasks.answer: 特殊旅客预订详情页匹配 TravelerBookingDetailScreen：导出名 TravelerBookingDetailScreen，导入路径 @/features/traveler-bookings/booking-detail-screen；必填 props 为 bookId。
底部弹出层匹配 UiPopup：导出名 UiPopup，导入路径 @/components/ui/overlay；onClose 必填，open 默认 false，position 默认 bottom，safeArea 默认 false。
登录页为 SignInPage：导出名 SignInPage，导入路径 @/features/auth/sign-in-page；顶部导航栏为 UiNavBar：导出名 UiNavBar，导入路径 @/components/ui/navigation。二者均无必填 props。
航班延误补偿列表页匹配 FlightDelayCompensationListScreen：导出名 FlightDelayCompensationListScreen，导入路径 @/features/flight-delay-compensation/list-screen；必填 props 为 context 和 onContextChange。
图片查看器匹配 UiImageViewer：导出名 UiImageViewer，导入路径 @/components/ui/image-viewer；必填 props 为 image、open、onClose。

notes: Group B held-out, 57-entry catalog with English vocabulary aliases. Exactly one catalog search per task (5 total), no get, no second search, no source/component-catalog.json/config/help/ls/cat/grep reads; target repo untouched. B1: best/only match is TravelerBookingDetailScreen (traveler booking detail); 'special passenger' qualifier is not explicit in the summary, hence medium confidence. B3: single search returned both SignInPage (login page) and UiNavBar (top nav bar). Other tasks matched exact top hits with high confidence.
